title: KR-mod9-lean
summary: Lean 4 proofs of the three Kanade-Russell identities modulo nine as identities of integer formal power series, including coefficientwise summability of the defining double sums. The development includes concrete vertex-operator spanning bounds and the character evaluations used to identify the sums with their infinite products.
